product_contract.ci_hygiene: The scanner is read-only, creates no temporary files, and detects stale exceptions so policy debt cleans up after retired files.
product_contract.cloud_native: Exceptions must point toward Rust cloud-ci, Kubernetes, GitOps, controller, or admission-policy replacements.
product_contract.execution: Buck2-native Rust gate; no Cargo command is required for enforcement.
product_contract.portability: Policy is data-driven so another repository can adopt the same gate by changing scan roots and exceptions.

purpose: Rust-first automation hygiene ratchet. Non-Rust scripts are blocked unless explicitly exceptioned as shrinkable debt with a Rust/Buck2/cloud-native replacement path.

workflow_inline_shell._comment: pipeline-glue(a): the file-extension scan above is blind to shell that lives INSIDE workflow YAML `run:` steps (the file is `.yml`, not `.sh`). This dimension parses the declared workflow roots with a real YAML parser, emits one keyed observation per (file, job, step) carrying an inline `run:` block, and ratchets it shrink-only against the frozen keyed baseline face rust-first-automation-workflow-shell-baseline.json. New inline shell beyond baseline is born-blocking; a retired step must shrink the baseline in the same PR. Removing the shell itself (productizing it as a Rust/Buck2 step) is pipeline-glue(b).

workflow_inline_shell_baseline._comment: FROZEN keyed baseline of TODAY's accepted legacy-bridge inline shell inside GitHub workflow YAML `run:` steps (pipeline-glue(a)). The file-extension scan (scan.non_rust_extensions over scan.roots) counts non-Rust automation FILES and is structurally blind to shell INSIDE a `.yml` (the file is a `.yml`, not a `.sh`). The scan.workflow_inline_shell dimension closes that blind spot: it parses the declared workflow roots with a real YAML parser and emits one keyed observation per (file, job, step) carrying an inline `run:` block. This baseline freezes that surface SHRINK-ONLY. Each key is `<workflow-relpath>::<job-id>::step-<N>` (N = 0-based step index within the job's `steps` array) -- the finest defensible per-(file,job,step) unit. The live-repo gate test asserts the MEASURED inline-shell key set equals codes.rust_first_automation_unbaselined_workflow_inline_shell EXACTLY (set equality): a NEW inline `run:` step beyond this baseline is born-blocking (rust_first_automation_unbaselined_workflow_inline_shell), a RETIRED step must shrink the baseline in the SAME PR (rust_first_automation_workflow_inline_shell_baseline_stale). Folded INTO this policy (an already-accounted gate face) rather than a new sibling JSON so adding the baseline creates ZERO new tracked accounting rows (no firewall ratchet growth). NOT producer-regenerated -- reviewed, hand-shrunk; anti-laundering is REVIEW-VISIBLE. REMOVING the shell itself (productizing each step as a Rust/Buck2 step) is pipeline-glue(b), a separate PR. FRIC-017: the FRIC-017 disk-reclaim `run:` blocks in oya-ci-required.yml are now COUNTED visible debt pending rust-first productization in pipeline-glue(b); the FRIC-017 ledger row stays OPEN.
